verdict.rationale: Docs confirm agents perform real actions like refunds, order changes, and subscription updates via integrations (decagon-docs-32, decagon-docs-33) and describe scoped, short-lived JWT access for minimal privilege (decagon-docs-2, decagon-docs-21), but there's no detail on per-action scoping granularity (e.g., different auth scopes for refund vs. subscription change) or independent verification of this in production. Missing for 10: per-action scope configuration examples, third-party/hands-on validation of action execution and auth enforcement.
